meta.title: FinLens — your money, under control
meta.description: FinLens is a personal-finance app: accounts, transactions, budgets, goals and clear statistics. Dark theme, multi-currency, and your data stays on your phone.

hero.title: Your money, at a glance
hero.subtitle: FinLens brings accounts, transactions, budgets and goals into one app. A clean dark theme, multi-currency support, and full control over your data.
hero.note: Your data is stored locally on your device.

features.title: Everything you need to track your finances
features.subtitle: Five sections that cover everyday money management — from balance to analytics.

items.name: Balance
items.desc: All accounts, assets and liabilities in one place. Net worth is calculated automatically, grouped clearly.

items.name: Ledger
items.desc: Add income, expenses and transfers in seconds. Categories, tags and search keep your history at hand.

items.name: Planner
items.desc: Category budgets and limits, savings goals, recurring payments and a schedule of what's coming up.

items.name: Insight
items.desc: Clear charts of spending and income, monthly trends, and a real understanding of where money goes.

items.name: More
items.desc: Multi-currency, tags, a privacy mode that hides amounts, plus backup and restore of your data.

screens.title: Considered down to the detail
screens.subtitle: A dark theme, bold figures and tidy typography make it a pleasure to use every day.

steps.title: Add your accounts
steps.desc: Cash, cards, deposits, loans — set up your accounts and opening balances in a couple of minutes.

steps.title: Record transactions
steps.desc: Log income and expenses by category. Recurring payments can be set up just once.

steps.title: Track your progress
steps.desc: Budgets, goals and analytics give you the full picture and help keep your money on track.

items.a: Your data is stored locally on your device. You can back it up and restore it whenever you need.

items.q: Are manat and other currencies supported?
items.a: Yes. FinLens supports multiple currencies, including the Turkmen manat (TMT), and can keep accounts in different currencies.
The interface is available in Turkmen and Russian.

items.q: How much does the app cost?
items.a: We're preparing to launch. Leave a request through the form below and we'll let you know as soon as it's available.
The app is built around usability and privacy, without intrusive advertising.

contact.title: Request access
contact.subtitle: Want to be the first to know about the launch, or have a question? Drop us a line.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
body: This page explains how we handle the data you send through the form on this site.
Through the contact form we receive the name, email and message you provide. We use this data only to reply to you and to notify you about the app launch.
We do not share your data with third parties and do not use it for advertising. Technical data (IP address, device type) is stored for spam protection.
The FinLens app itself stores your financial data locally on your device. We have no access to it.
For any questions about your data, contact us through the form on this site.
